description: Use when the user asks if a domain's SPF record is valid, why a sender fails SPF or if it hits the 10-lookup limit. Returns the include tree, all qualifier and lookup counts. For the IP ranges use spf_flatten. Ex: 'Is the SPF of example.com valid?'. Free trial without an API key: a few calls a day.

domain.description: A public domain name, e.g. example.com.
